policy_description.traceability: Verified negative criterion is sufficient for DO_NOT_ADVANCE; ADVANCE requires all three positive criteria to be verified.
policy_description.stability: Require unanimous actionable decisions only when semantic equivalence is YES. Otherwise, retain individual traceability decisions without a stability inference.

limitations: Development evaluation only; no held-out data.
Text verification does not establish substantive evidence sufficiency.
NO and UNCERTAIN groups are not certified stable; the gate is simply not applied.
The three variants are correlated within scenario families.
Changes were specified after examining development diagnostic failures.
